description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : Communes impactées par une canalisation de transport de matières dangereuses (surfacique) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigena.fr. This dataset contains the perimeters of the municipalities impacted by an effect band of a pipeline for the transport of dangerous goods, in the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "New Aquitaine: Municipalities impacted by a pipeline for the transport of dangerous goods (surfacic)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include matières dangeureuses, transport, tmd, données ouvertes, canalisation, nouvelle-aquitaine. The listing shows 2017-05-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
